title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - TestDataInstance
description: A managed test data instance resource (TM Forum TMF706 Test Data 4.0.0, Swagger definition TestDataInstance; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:TestDataInstance:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'TestDataInstance'

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF706_TestData/blob/v4.0.0/TMF706-TestData-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TestDataInstance/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:TestDataInstance:<tmfId>. unique identifier

relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF706_TestData/blob/v4.0.0/TMF706-TestData-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TestDataInstance/properties/relatedParty'. Related party specialization that includes contact information
